exposure: Hysterectomy as initial treatment for complete hydatidiform mole (CHM)
Uterine evacuation as initial treatment for complete hydatidiform mole (CHM)
outcome: Need for chemotherapy for hCG normalization
cohort: The study included 275 women aged 40 years or older diagnosed with complete hydatidiform mole (CHM).
finding: Hysterectomy as initial treatment for CHM in women 40 years or older was associated with a significantly lower risk of GTN development and requiring chemotherapy compared to uterine evacuation.
